note: Hand-kept, not extracted. The notes printed under these tables are prose, and the parser marks the rows they qualify without copying them. What a note states is restated here in this project's own words, together with the part of it a measurement can be held against. Nothing here is a transcription, and nothing here is a measurement.
why_it_matters: The initial-value column is not the value a unit powers up holding. It is what the document says the unit is left at, and these notes are where it says which message leaves it there. Read without them, a row like 40 1x 0A reads as a document disagreeing with a measurement -- its cell says 00 and the unit powers up holding 01 -- when what the document actually states is what two of this unit's three resets were measured to do.

qualifications.restated: The document states that receiving the value 00 here does what receiving GS Reset does.

The document states elsewhere on this page that selecting an insertion effect type sets that effect's parameters as a group. The initial value in this row is therefore what selecting a type leaves here, not what the unit powers up holding -- and the archive's own effect map records every one of the sixty-five types this unit accepted loading 40 into this address, which is the value stated.
The document states that this is set off by GM1 System On and by GM2 System On, and on by GS Reset.
The document states no single initial value for this address. It states one for the SC-8850, SC-88Pro and SC-88 maps, and another for the SC-55 map that depends on whether the part is the drum part.
The document states no single initial value for this address: it depends on the part number.
The document states that this is set off by GM1 System On, and on by GS Reset and by GM2 System On.
The document states that while this is off, a Bank Select LSB message is treated as though its value were 00 whatever it carries.
The document states that GS Reset leaves this at 00.
The document states that this address names a map only while TONE MAP NUMBER is 00. What it does at any other value of that address the document does not say.

qualifies_note: Each entry says what its note qualifies. `initial` means the note is about the initial value, so the value in that cell is not the whole of what the document states there and no verdict is put on it. `behaviour` means the note is about what the setting does, which leaves the initial value comparable as printed -- a note is not a reason to stop comparing something it says nothing about.
